verdict.rationale: Obsidian has no first-party AI/LLM connector in the docs pack, but its general plugin architecture (obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-31, obsidian-docs-33) supports third-party integrations, and community evidence confirms real-world AI plugins like Text-Generator are used to pull note context into LLM inference (obsidian-comm-7). However the same source notes there's 'no decent RAG functionality among Obsidian AI plugins,' indicating the ecosystem is functional but limited/immature rather than a robust first-party AI integration. Missing for 10: an official Obsidian AI connector/plugin, documentation of specific AI plugin APIs, and broader corroboration beyond one community comment.
